resources.string: Free up Xiaomi HyperOS Security Center: power, permissions and network limits, plus Google features.
No switch is on yet. Turn hooks on in the System or Google tab and they show up here.
Not connected to LSPosed, so the switches cannot be read yet.
Add Security Center to this module\'s scope in LSPosed.
Enable All4Hyper in LSPosed, then open it again.
Could not restart. Check root access.
Approve the request in the LSPosed notification
The scope request was not approved
Performance, power saving and super saving modes stop changing.
Keeps apps, background and notifications out of the strict saving state.
Keeps the refresh rate, brightness and screen timeout as they are.
Security Center stops sending thermal limits. Watch the temperature.
Install, chain launch, device ID, screen recording, accessibility and AI screen control can no longer be restricted.
One-tap clean-up no longer kills background processes.
Apps cannot be denied auto-start from Security Center.
Wi-Fi and mobile data rules are changed to Allow.
Apps keep their connection in the background.
Keep data on after the limit
No automatic cut-off when the data plan limit is reached.
Hotspot sharing is not stopped at its traffic limit.
Security Center no longer aborts installs at its own verification step.
Log every intercepted call to LSPosed under the tag All4Hyper.
The hook targets were found by reading MeowPower by yuhj319. The code here is a fresh implementation, not a copy.

Makes the Google app a system app, tells the system that Circle to Search and its live translate are supported, and sets the power key and navigation handle to Google on every boot. It is installed with root and needs a reboot.
Needs root to read the module state.
Turn it on again in your root manager, then reboot.
This app brings a newer version, with a switch for the power key.
Could not install the companion. Check root access.
Could not change the key. Check root access.
Saved. System-level changes apply after a reboot.
Saved, but without root the key stays as it is until the next boot.
Sets the power key to Google and keeps the assistant running after a clean-up. Choose Google as your digital assistant in Settings → Apps → Default apps.
Long-press the handle opens Circle to Search
Sends the handle\'s long press, and the side swipe-and-hold, to Circle to Search even when XiaoAi would answer it.
A short tick, like on a Pixel.
Google Play services features work as on a global ROM, Quick Share included, with its control center tile.
In Circle to Search, tap Translate and keep translating as you scroll.
Android restarts its software (a soft reboot): the screen goes dark for a moment and every app is closed. No data is lost.
Power Keeper and Mi Settings (for per-app refresh rate) must be in this module\'s scope.
Power Keeper stops changing the refresh rate per scene; the display stays at its top rate.
Power Keeper does not lower brightness or refresh rate because of heat.
Unlocks the per-app refresh rate page in Settings and has Power Keeper follow it. Needs the Mi Settings scope.
Power Keeper does not kill app processes. May use more battery.
Stops Power Keeper from putting its batch of apps back on the unoptimized list, so your choices stay.
Google Play services keeps network, alarms and push while the phone sleeps. Needs the System scope.
After changing a switch, restart Power Keeper from the restart button in the top bar. \"GMS online at all times\" needs a system restart.
